posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Got mint, too.

 

Used the volcano Flesh of the Sun God trick--forgot that it only protects Character cards, so was sad to see swift bot go on the first (second, maybe?) eruption.

Tempest went down, but he had used cleansing downpour a couple of times, so that helped me not sweat as much.

I left the charged attacks in play the whole time.

A big Haka of battle took Ambuscade from 21 down to 6, then Raptor bot took him to 2 (Imbued fire and obsidian field), then flame spike for the win.

 

I really like these weekly one-shots.  It's scratching the itch I have for a story/campaign mode. (I know there are fan-made campaigns, and they're great, but this feels more "official." I don't know why that matters to me....)

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Unity was pretty awesome in my local game, ending the game with 2 Raptor Bots and Swift Bot in play. If should would have gotten another turn then Platform Bot would have joined the party. 2 of the three games I have played online did have a lackluster Unity, which of course were ones where the other players wanted to leave Volcanic Eruption in play.

Personally, I had no reason to leave Volcanic Eruption in play. I don't need to rely on the environment to do my work for me against an actor.
